note: Client retry policy (one model for every SDK). Classified by status, code and, for 429, the limitType member.

classes.never: no retry: 400, 401, 403, 404, and 429 with limitType "monthly" or a limitType the client does not know
classes.once-after-burst-wait: one retry after Retry-After seconds, 10 when the header is missing (configurable, can be off): 429 with limitType "burst"
classes.backoff: exponential backoff: 5xx, non-JSON gateway errors and network errors, POST search included

requestId: one X-Request-Id per logical call, reused on every retry
